crossRefs.note: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done…
Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and…
Some therefore cried one thing, and some another, for the assembly was in confusion. Most of them didn’t know why they…

translations.web: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.
translations.bsb: What then should we do? They will certainly hear that you have come.
translations.kjv: What is it therefore? the multitude must needs come together: for they will hear that thou art come.
translations.asv: What is it therefore? They will certainly hear that thou art come.
